title: Almost Acyclic Graph
statementMd:
You are given a [directed graph](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Directed_graph) consisting of $*n*$ vertices and $*m*$ edges (each edge is directed, so it can be traversed in only one direction). You are allowed to remove at most one edge from it.

Can you make this graph [acyclic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Directed_acyclic_graph) by removing at most one edge from it? A directed graph is called acyclic iff it doesn't contain any cycle (a non-empty path that starts and ends in the same vertex).

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 500$, $1 ≤ *m* ≤ *min*(*n*(*n* - 1), 100000)$) — the number of vertices and the number of edges, respectively.

Then $*m*$ lines follow. Each line contains two integers $*u*$ and $*v*$ denoting a directed edge going from vertex $*u*$ to vertex $*v*$ ($1 ≤ *u*, *v* ≤ *n*$, $*u* ≠ *v*$). Each ordered pair $(*u*, *v*)$ is listed at most once (there is at most one directed edge from $*u*$ to $*v*$).

## Output

If it is possible to make this graph acyclic by removing at most one edge, print `YES`. Otherwise, print `NO`.

## Note

In the first example you can remove edge ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29f71c065c3536e88b54429c734103ad3604f68b.png), and the graph becomes acyclic.

In the second example you have to remove at least two edges (for example, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/420322fe5fba4eb3e3eba6886a2edb31f15762ce.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29f71c065c3536e88b54429c734103ad3604f68b.png)) in order to make the graph acyclic.
statementZhMd:
给定一个由 $*n*$ 个顶点和 $*m*$ 条边组成的[有向图](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Directed_graph)（每条边都有方向，因此只能沿一个方向 traversed）。你可以从中删除至多一条边。

你能否通过删除至多一条边，使这个图变为[无环图](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Directed_acyclic_graph)？当且仅当有向图不包含任何环（从某个顶点出发并回到同一顶点的非空路径）时，称其为无环图。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 500$，$1 ≤ *m* ≤ *min*(*n*(*n* - 1), 100000)$），分别表示顶点数和边数。

接下来 $*m*$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$，表示一条从顶点 $*u*$ 指向顶点 $*v*$ 的有向边（$1 ≤ *u*, *v* ≤ *n*$，$*u* ≠ *v*$）。每个有序对 $(*u*, *v*)$ 至多出现一次（即从 $*u*$ 到 $*v*$ 至多有一条有向边）。

## 输出格式

如果可以通过删除至多一条边使该图变为无环图，输出 `YES`。否则，输出 `NO`。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，你可以删除边 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29f71c065c3536e88b54429c734103ad3604f68b.png)，此时图将变为无环图。

在第二个样例中，为了使图变为无环图，至少需要删除两条边（例如删除 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/420322fe5fba4eb3e3eba6886a2edb31f15762ce.png) 和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29f71c065c3536e88b54429c734103ad3604f68b.png)）。
